mainEntity.name: How long do functional layout improvement projects typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of functional layout improvement projects depends on their complexity and size. Minor reconfigurations might take a few weeks, while more extensive projects involving structural changes or multiple room redesigns could take several months. We provide a projected timeline during the planning phase, taking into account permitting, material lead times, and construction schedules. Our aim is to complete your project efficiently while maintaining quality.
